verdict.rationale: Helicone documents Sessions that group related requests and paths that mark the same type of work, which supports session- and feature-level grouping. The webhook docs also imply custom request properties exist, and per-user handling appears in rate limits, cache namespaces and cost alerts. However, nothing in the pack explicitly shows cost or usage being broken down by user, session or custom property, so attribution is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit custom-properties/metadata documentation, per-user cost and usage attribution, cost rollups per session or feature, independent hands-on corroboration of cost attribution.
